title: failure-mode-expected
description: Per-fixture expected verdicts + reviewer signal for the failure-mode eval set.

kind.description: Whether the diff exhibits the pattern (buggy) or is a clean control that must not flag.

class.description: Failure class from the catalog (front-end, back-end-memory, coherence, ...).

should_flag.description: For kind=buggy: one line per expected reviewer callout. For kind=control: empty — the reviewer must not flag anything.

flag_terms.description: Parallel to should_flag (same length, same order). Each element is a list of 2-4 lowercase alternative terms or short phrases a reviewer who caught that callout would plausibly write; the runner grades should_flag coverage by case-insensitive substring match of these against the reviewer's findings. Terms must not echo the PR description or Intent in context.md. Empty for kind=control.

runtime_evidence.description: Optional. Runtime detectors (TMA, perf c2c, PEBS) that would confirm the finding, per catalog entry.
